create_HiddenDecoder: create a HiddenDecoder to extract watermark bits from a watermarked image using HiDDeN
create_HiddenEncoder: create a HiddenEncoder to insert a watermark message into an image using HiDDeN
get_hidden_decoder: get a HiDDeN decoder model with configurable num bits, redundancy, blocks, and channels
get_hidden_encoder: get a HiDDeN encoder model with configurable num bits, blocks, and channels
load_model_from_config: load a Latent Diffusion Model from a config file and checkpoint path
